gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-comme: Comme reads smooth and modern, its lowercase filling most of the letter height with no clogged curves. And Minecraftia earns its place big and brief, where its heavy ink and hairline strokes can stand out.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte reads clean and generous, with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes and n arches as thick as their stems. But Minecraftia's thread-thin strokes beside heavy ones give way to a body that holds a long stretch of text steadily.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-duru-sans: Minecraftia lingers on fat verticals and whisper-thin lines that snag the eye, while Duru Sans keeps its small letters wide open and dominant. Give the heading more size than the body.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-fresca: Minecraftia brings ink-heavy stems and feather-thin lines, a playful, familiar look that lingers on each character. But Fresca keeps one plain stroke throughout, with short ascenders above big bowls, so it is worth giving the heading the larger size.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-funnel-sans: Sudden jumps from thick to thin give Minecraftia its jittery, fun lingering beat, one character at a time. Funnel Sans then bends its tubing-like strokes into loops, so the sans-serif body settles the page.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-gafata: Gafata reads contemporary and businesslike, a tall band of lowercase with short stalks above and wide-eyed e shapes. Shrink Minecraftia, and its hairline details vanish.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-geist: Fat downstrokes, wispy upstrokes: Minecraftia has a familiar, playful swagger. And Geist, a plain sans with a quiet level beat and no accents of weight, makes words land as solid blocks.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-georama: Approachable is the mood Georama sets, with a c pulled open like a bracelet and capitals that barely rise. And Minecraftia adds punchy swells and razor-fine thins above it, lingering one character per beat.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-gidole: Strong weight shifts, extreme and playful: that is Minecraftia, a heading that lingers on every character. Gidole, a plain sans, does the opposite job, keeping its terminals apart and every stroke as consistent as neon tube.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-golos-text: Golos Text reads contemporary and friendly, with an x-height filling the line and a widely parted s. Make Minecraftia small and its heavy strokes lose their wispy partners.
